items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: I wouldn't say Freddie's been out over eight years, or more.

ctx.x: He was -- I think the Ambassador, I think he was a little later than some of these others. Freddie
hasn't been out too long, I don't believe. I wouldn't say Freddie's been out over eight years, or more. I really don't know right now.
Did places like the Coconut Grove and the Ambassador Hotel have just big bands, or did they have other acts too? They had dancers --
